The Conceptual Quantitative section features a prompt describing two muffins and three-quarters of another muffin, with images depicting muffins in different arrangements. The Exact Number Generation section includes a prompt for seven pairs of jeans and three down jackets, with images showing clothing items arranged on racks. Each example includes model attributions and visual outputs that reflect the model’s interpretation of the numerical instructions.
